claim_summary: The paper contributes an LLM-driven forecasting agent that diagnoses and preprocesses temporal data, selects and tunes forecasters using validation results, adaptively ensembles them, and reports its decisions.

claim_evidence.quote: To this end, we introduce TimeSeriesScientist (TSci), the first end-to-end, agentic framework that leverages multimodal knowledge to automate the entire workflow a human scientist would follow for univariate time series forecasting.

modules.name: Temporal diagnostics and preprocessing
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK=no: the module does not optimize a forecast loss or encode a forecast output criterion; rolling-window cleaning and temporal profiling remain meaningful for other time-series tasks. R3_2 GTS=yes: it operates on the ordered series and its local windows.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - no forecast-specific objective or validation criterion
R3_2_GTS:yes - depends on ordered temporal data and local windows

evidence.quote: Rather than computing fixed summaries, Curator leverages LLM-driven reasoning to both diagnose issues and execute appropriate preprocessing.

To effectively support downstream forecasting, an overall analysis is important in uncovering temporal structures and statistical properties that are essential for informed model selection and interpretation.

modules.name: Validation-driven forecaster selection
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK=yes: the procedure selects and tunes forecasting models against forecast validation MAPE; changing task family changes its objective and model-selection criterion. R3_2 GTS is not reached.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - selects forecasting models by forecast validation performance

evidence.quote: Planner extracts visual features from visualizations V via lightwise pattern recognition and LLM reasoning. It then maps the recognized data pattern to suitable model families and forms a candidate pool

modules.name: Validation-guided ensemble forecasting
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK=yes: the module chooses a forecast ensemble strategy from candidate forecast validation results and produces the final prediction; its objective and validation criterion are forecasting-specific. R3_2 GTS is not reached.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - selects a forecasting ensemble from forecast validation results

evidence.quote: Forecaster takes the top-k selected models Mselected and their validation metrics Sval as input. The agent leverages an LLM-guided policy to select an ensemble strategy from among three families: single–best selection, performance-aware averaging, or robust aggregation.
The ensemble strategy and (if applicable) weights are fixed before touching the test set to avoid data leakage.

modules.name: Forecasting report generation
modules.scope_reason: R3_1 TSK=yes: the introduced report consolidates forecast results, ensemble forecast and task-specific model rationales for the forecasting workflow. R3_2 GTS is not reached because the reporting interface does not itself manage temporal data.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - produces a forecast-specific report and output

evidence.quote: Reporter outputs a comprehensive report R that consolidates all intermediate statistical analyses and forecasting results.

an interpretability report in which an LLM generates natural-language explanations of (i) the rationale for selecting specific models, (ii) the derivation of ensemble weights, (iii) the system’s confidence in its forecast, and (iv) any underlying assumptions or limitations
